description: A warm, friendly man in his thirties or forties with a clear, natural baritone voice, a native Korean speaker with a standard Seoul Korean accent. He says a short prayer aloud the way people say it together in church every day: fluent and flowing, at a normal conversational speed, warm and sincere, without dragging and without dramatic pauses.
ref_text: 영광이 성부와 성자와 성령께, 처음과 같이 이제와 항상 영원히. 아멘.

design_qa.transcript: 영광히 성부와 성자와 성령께, 처음과 같이 이제와 항상 영원히. 아멘.
